issue.title: lib: allow long paths for require on Windows

labels.name: module
labels.description: Issues and PRs related to the module subsystem.

issue.body:
https://github.com/nodejs/io.js/pull/1801 introduced internal fs methods to speed up require.
The methods do not call path._makeLong like their counterpart
from the fs module. This brings back the old behaviour.

Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/io.js/issues/1990
Fixes: https://github.com/nodejs/io.js/issues/1980
